title: M3AAWG Best Practices for Sending Legally Mandated Emails to Large Audiences
abstract: This version 2.0 best-practice guide sets out responsibilities for brand owners, email infrastructure operators and deliverability consultants when sending legally mandated bulk notifications, including breach notices. It addresses domain authentication, recognizable sending domains, DNS configuration, recipient ordering, restrained message content, accessibility, proof of sending, and coordination with service and mailbox providers. It also describes alternatives to email. This is operational industry guidance; its relevance is primarily incident-response communications rather than evidence collection.

title: “A Recurring Pattern”: Civilians Paying the Price in Mali’s Drone Campaign
authors: Sebastian Vandermeersch, Conflict and Human Rights Team
abstract: This Bellingcat and Jeune Afrique investigation examines reported civilian harm from Malian military drone strikes. It locates strike and aftermath footage using satellite imagery and visible landmarks, compares imagery before and after attacks, and checks official claims against humanitarian reporting and witness accounts. Worked examples in Zouera, Amasrakad and Tinzaouaten expose the reasoning behind the geolocations. The investigation discloses cases where casualty identities or civilian status could not be confirmed and records attempts to obtain a military response.
